title: An opaque room reveals itself while a PC is inside and re-hides when he leaves
source: Re-hiding a room when the party leaves (phase 1 vision, optional)
description: The room is an opaque rect zone, 6x6 at [10, 10] (x 7..13, y 7..13), with visible_to a formula over the pcs inside it. goblin1 (visible_to all) stands inside at [10, 10]; goblin2 (visible_to all) stands outside at [20, 20]. The room's z is 1 and the goblins' 0, so the cover is stated to lie over goblin1 rather than left to a default. Aldric's token (tag pc) enters at [9, 10] and leaves to [0, 0]. Then, with Aldric inside, the GM types all over visible_to: the override stops the formula, so leaving no longer re-hides; clearing it resumes the formula.

expect.note: "visible_to = if(len(contents(this).where(tag has "pc")) > 0, all, gm)": no pc's anchor is inside, so gm.

"Before entry: `object_visible` of the room and of the goblin are false for Aldric" (FIXTURES §9). FIXTURES §7: `object_visible` is the effective visibility "and not drawn under the cover of an opaque zone the viewer cannot see"; the room's own visible_to is gm.

FIXTURES §7: "a goblin marked `all` inside a hidden opaque room is not visible to Aldric". DESIGN §4.4: "a viewer who cannot see the zone sees its region drawn as a solid cover over everything beneath it, including objects they could otherwise see."
"true for the GM" (FIXTURES §9). DESIGN §4.4: "The GM always sees everything."
"true for the GM" (FIXTURES §9). DESIGN §4.4: "The GM always sees everything."

FIXTURES §7: `object_visible` is the effective visibility "and not drawn under the cover of an opaque zone the viewer cannot see"; goblin2 is visible_to all and outside the room's region, so no cover is over it.
"Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so." Nothing has been set by hand yet, so no override.

steps.note: The GM sets the room's visible_to to all by hand.

expect.note: "Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so." "an `override` of `visible_to` ... asserted with `override: true`" (FIXTURES §9).
DESIGN §4.2: "The override is visible as such, and the cell stops following its inputs"; the cell holds the typed all.
FIXTURES §7: `object_visible` is the effective visibility "and not drawn under the cover of an opaque zone the viewer cannot see"; the room's visible_to is all.

steps.note: Aldric leaves; the room stays revealed.

expect.note: "Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so." The formula would give gm, but the override holds all.
"Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so."
"moving the PC out no longer re-hides the room" (FIXTURES §9).

DESIGN §4.4: "a viewer who cannot see the zone sees its region drawn as a solid cover over everything beneath it, including objects they could otherwise see." Aldric can see the room, so it covers nothing for him and the goblin's own all applies.

steps.note: The GM clears the override; the formula resumes.
